name: search_anime
description: Search for anime by title. Returns title, score, type, episode count, status, synopsis, and genres.

query.description: Anime title to search for (e.g., "Fullmetal Alchemist")

name: get_anime
description: Get full details for an anime by ID. Returns score, synopsis, genres, studios, episode count, and more.

id.description: MyAnimeList anime ID (e.g., 5114 for Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood)

name: top_anime
description: Get top-ranked anime, optionally filtered by type (e.g., "tv", "movie", "ova", "ona"). Returns titles, scores, and rankings.

type.description: Filter by anime type: tv, movie, ova, special, ona, music. Omit for all types.

name: search_characters
description: Search for anime/manga characters by name. Returns character names, nicknames, favorites count, and biography.
